Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Sand Point ADF&G Office Sand Point, AK 99661

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

Advisory Announcement: For Immediate Release: August 24, 2026 Time: 5:00 p.m.

CONTACT: Matt Keyse, Finfish Area Management Biologist Annie Brewster, Assist. Area Management Biologist (907) 383-2066

Sand Point Commercial Salmon Fishery Advisory Announcement #24 For Emergency Order #4-FS-M-SP-22-26

Commercial salmon fishing by purse seine and set gillnet gear will be allowed for 109 hours from 8:00 a.m. Wednesday, August 26 until 9:00 p.m. Sunday, August 30 in the following districts and sections:

Unimak District, Southwestern District, South Central District, and Shumagin Islands, Beaver Bay, Balboa Bay, Southwest Stepovak, Northwest Stepovak, and East Stepovak Sections of the Southeastern District.

Commercial salmon fishing by drift gillnet gear will be allowed for 109 hours 8:00 a.m. Wednesday, August 26 until 9:00 p.m. Sunday, August 30 in the following districts and sections:

Unimak District, Ikatan Bay Section of the Southwestern District.

Commercial salmon fishing by purse seine, set gillnet, and drift gillnet gear will be allowed for 109 hours 8:00 a.m. Wednesday, August 26 until 9:00 p.m. Sunday, August 30 in the Bechevin Bay Section of the Northwestern District.

All closed waters will be as described in the regulation book or as adjusted by emergency order.
